artifacts.claimText: Khalifa University Library's Academic AI Tools guide establishes Responsible AI Use principles requiring researchers and students to keep critical judgment in the loop, verify claims and references against inaccurate or fabricated information, check course, university, journal, and funder rules, protect data before uploading personal or unpublished material, acknowledge AI use, and noting that tool inclusion does not mean approval for every academic context.

artifacts.evidenceSnippetOriginal: Keep your judgement in the loop. AI can support research and learning. Your critical thinking and scholarly judgement remain essential. Check the evidence AI can produce inaccurate, incomplete, biased or fabricated information. Protect your information Check data-handling rules before uploading personal, confidential or unpublished material. Before you choose a tool: Inclusion in this guide does not mean approval for every teaching, research, publishing or assessment context.
